title: The Cold Drop
author: Rafael Montrose
blurb: Ada Fairweather, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
